title: Repair can go either way
hook: A hole away from the root can break order in either direction.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Choose upward or downward repair after replacing an arbitrary deleted heap item.

misconception: Every heap deletion is repaired by sifting downward.
objective: Choose upward or downward repair after replacing an arbitrary deleted heap item.

claims.text: An arbitrary hole differs from a root hole: its replacement can violate order above or below. Comparing with the parent selects upward repair when needed; otherwise the replacement sifts down through its children.
